_comment: DHCP/BOOTP option and message-type names, sourced from the IANA 'BOOTP Vendor Extensions and DHCP Options' and 'DHCP Message Type 53 Values' registries (https://www.iana.org/assignments/bootp-dhcp-parameters/). Every option here has a correct `name`; `format` (see dhcp.rs's format_value) tells the UI how to render its value - options without one fall back to a hex dump. `description` + `rfc` (an option's defining standard) drive the hover tooltip on the option name in the DHCP tab; both are only set where confidently known - an option missing them just shows no tooltip rather than risking a wrong citation. Add/improve any of these fields here; no Rust changes needed.

options.name: Pad
options.description: No-op padding byte between options - carries no data.

options.name: Subnet Mask
options.description: The client's subnet mask.

options.name: Time Offset
options.description: Client's time zone offset from UTC, in seconds (deprecated by RFC 4833 in favor of options 100/101).

options.name: Router
options.description: Default gateway(s) for the client, in order of preference.

options.name: Time Server
options.description: RFC 868 Time Protocol servers.

options.name: Name Server
options.description: IEN 116 name servers (legacy, not DNS).

options.name: Domain Server
options.description: DNS servers for the client to use.

options.name: Log Server
options.description: RFC 3164 syslog servers.

options.name: Quotes Server
options.description: RFC 865 'Quote of the Day' servers.

options.name: LPR Server
options.description: RFC 1179 line-printer servers.

options.name: Impress Server
options.description: Imagen Impress print servers (obsolete).

options.name: RLP Server
options.description: Resource Location Protocol servers (obsolete).

options.name: Hostname
options.description: The client's requested or assigned hostname.

options.name: Boot File Size
options.description: Size of the default boot image, in 512-byte blocks.

options.name: Merit Dump File
options.description: Path to a file where the client should dump a crash/debug core.

options.name: Domain Name
options.description: The client's DNS domain, for resolving unqualified hostnames.

options.name: Swap Server
options.description: Address of the client's swap server (diskless clients).

options.name: Root Path
options.description: NFS path to the client's root filesystem (diskless clients).

options.name: Extension File
options.description: Path to a file with further BOOTP vendor extensions to load.

options.name: IP Forwarding
options.description: Whether the client should enable IP forwarding.

options.name: Non-Local Source Routing
options.description: Whether the client should accept non-local source-routed packets.

options.name: Policy Filter
options.description: Destination/mask pairs the client should use to filter non-local source routes.

options.name: Max Datagram Reassembly
options.description: Largest datagram size the client should be prepared to reassemble.

options.name: Default IP TTL
options.description: Default TTL the client should use on outgoing packets.

options.name: Path MTU Aging Timeout
options.description: Timeout for aging Path MTU Discovery (RFC 1191) values.

options.name: Path MTU Plateau Table
options.description: MTU sizes to try during Path MTU Discovery.

options.name: Interface MTU
options.description: MTU the client should use on its interface.

options.name: All Subnets Are Local
options.description: Whether all subnets of the client's network are directly reachable.

options.name: Broadcast Address
options.description: The broadcast address to use on the client's subnet.

options.name: Perform Mask Discovery
options.description: Whether the client should use ICMP Mask Discovery (RFC 950).

options.name: Mask Supplier
options.description: Whether the client should respond to ICMP Mask Discovery requests.

options.name: Perform Router Discovery
options.description: Whether the client should use Router Discovery (RFC 1256).

options.name: Router Solicitation Address
options.description: Address the client should use for Router Solicitation.

options.name: Static Route
options.description: Destination/router pairs for static routes (superseded by option 121's classless routes).

options.name: Trailer Encapsulation
options.description: Whether the client should negotiate trailer encapsulation (RFC 893).

options.name: ARP Cache Timeout
options.description: Timeout for entries in the client's ARP cache.

options.name: Ethernet Encapsulation
options.description: Whether to use RFC 894 or RFC 1042 Ethernet encapsulation.

options.name: Default TCP TTL
options.description: Default TTL the client should use for outgoing TCP segments.

options.name: TCP Keepalive Interval
options.description: Interval for the client to send TCP keepalive messages.

options.name: TCP Keepalive Garbage
options.description: Whether TCP keepalive messages should include a garbage octet (legacy interop).

options.name: NIS Domain
options.description: The client's Network Information Service (NIS) domain.

options.name: NIS Servers
options.description: NIS servers for the client's domain.

options.name: NTP Servers
options.description: NTP servers for the client to synchronize time with.

options.name: Vendor Specific Information
options.description: Opaque, vendor-defined data - format depends entirely on the vendor.

options.name: NetBIOS Name Server
options.description: WINS/NetBIOS name servers.

options.name: NetBIOS Datagram Distribution Server
options.description: NetBIOS datagram distribution servers.

options.name: NetBIOS Node Type
options.description: NetBIOS node type (b/p/m/h-node).

options.name: NetBIOS Scope
options.description: The client's NetBIOS scope ID.

options.name: X Window Font Server
options.description: X Window System font servers.

options.name: X Window Display Manager
options.description: X Window System display manager servers.

options.name: Requested IP Address
options.description: Address the client is requesting, typically in a DISCOVER or REQUEST.

options.name: IP Address Lease Time
options.description: How long the offered/assigned address is valid for.

options.name: Option Overload
options.description: Signals that the legacy 'sname'/'file' header fields are reused to carry more options.

options.name: DHCP Message Type
options.description: Which DHCP message this is (DISCOVER, OFFER, REQUEST, ACK, ...).

options.name: DHCP Server Identifier
options.description: Identifies which server sent this, or which server a REQUEST is directed to.

options.name: Parameter Request List
options.description: Options the client is asking the server to include in its reply.

options.name: DHCP Message
options.description: Human-readable text, typically explaining a NAK.

options.name: Maximum DHCP Message Size
options.description: Largest DHCP message the client can accept.

options.name: Renewal (T1) Time Value
options.description: When the client should start trying to renew with the original server.

options.name: Rebinding (T2) Time Value
options.description: When the client should start trying to rebind with any server.

options.name: Vendor Class Identifier
options.description: Identifies the client's vendor/type, e.g. for PXE clients.

options.name: Client Identifier
options.description: A unique identifier the server uses for this client's lease, instead of its MAC address.

options.name: NetWare/IP Domain
options.description: The client's NetWare/IP domain name.

options.name: NetWare/IP Option
options.description: NetWare/IP-specific sub-options.

options.name: NIS+ Domain
options.description: The client's NIS+ domain.

options.name: NIS+ Servers
options.description: NIS+ servers for the client's domain.

options.name: TFTP Server Name
options.description: Name/address of the TFTP server for the next stage of booting.

options.name: Bootfile Name
options.description: Name of the boot file to load from the TFTP server.

options.name: Home Agent Addresses
options.description: Mobile IP home agent addresses.

options.name: SMTP Server
options.description: SMTP mail servers.

options.name: POP3 Server
options.description: POP3 mail servers.

options.name: NNTP Server
options.description: NNTP news servers.

options.name: WWW Server
options.description: Default WWW servers.

options.name: Finger Server
options.description: Finger protocol servers.

options.name: IRC Server
options.description: IRC servers.

options.name: StreetTalk Server
options.description: StreetTalk servers (obsolete directory service).

options.name: StreetTalk Directory Assistance Server
options.description: StreetTalk Directory Assistance servers.

options.name: User Class
options.description: Identifies a class of client, letting the server group clients (e.g. VoIP phones vs. laptops).

options.name: Directory Agent
options.description: Service Location Protocol (SLP) directory agents.

options.name: Service Scope
options.description: SLP scope the client should use.

options.name: Rapid Commit
options.description: Requests/confirms the abbreviated DISCOVER-ACK exchange, skipping OFFER/REQUEST.

options.name: Client FQDN
options.description: The client's fully-qualified domain name, and who (client or server) should update DNS for it.

options.name: Relay Agent Information
options.description: Sub-options a relay agent inserts (e.g. Circuit ID/Remote ID) to identify where a request came from.

options.name: iSNS
options.description: Internet Storage Name Service server information.

options.name: NDS Servers
options.description: Novell Directory Services (NDS) servers.

options.name: NDS Tree Name
options.description: The client's NDS tree name.

options.name: NDS Context
options.description: The client's initial NDS context.

options.name: BCMCS Controller Domain Name List
options.description: Broadcast/Multicast Service Controller domain names (cellular networks).

options.name: BCMCS Controller IPv4 Address
options.description: Broadcast/Multicast Service Controller addresses.

options.name: Authentication
options.description: Cryptographic authentication of DHCP messages between client and server.

options.name: Client Last Transaction Time
options.description: Used with Leasequery: how long ago the client's last transaction was.

options.name: Associated IP
options.description: Used with Leasequery: other addresses associated with the queried client/lease.

options.name: Client System Architecture
options.description: The client's CPU/firmware architecture (e.g. BIOS x86, UEFI x64), for PXE network boot.

options.name: Client Network Device Interface
options.description: The client's network boot interface type and version (e.g. UNDI), for PXE.

options.name: UUID/GUID-based Client Identifier
options.description: A UUID/GUID identifying the client, common with PXE firmware.

options.name: User Authentication (Open Group)
options.description: Remote user authentication information, per an Open Group (not IETF) specification.

options.name: GeoConf Civic
options.description: Civic (street-address-style) location information for the client.

options.name: PCode (POSIX TZ String)
options.description: The client's POSIX TZ environment-variable string, for timezone configuration.

options.name: TCode (TZ Database Reference)
options.description: The client's IANA Time Zone Database (Olson) name, for timezone configuration.

options.name: IPv6-Only Preferred
options.description: How long the client should wait before falling back to IPv4 on an IPv6-mostly network.

options.name: DHCPv4 over DHCPv6 Softwire Source Address
options.description: Softwire source address used in DHCPv4-over-DHCPv6 provisioning.

options.name: NetInfo Parent Server Address
options.description: Apple NetInfo parent server address (legacy macOS directory service).

options.name: NetInfo Parent Server Tag
options.description: Apple NetInfo parent server tag.

options.name: DHCP Captive-Portal
options.description: URI of a captive portal the client is currently behind.

options.name: Auto-Configure
options.description: Tells the client whether it should attempt IPv4 link-local auto-configuration.

options.name: Name Service Search
options.description: Order in which the client should query different name-service types.

options.name: Subnet Selection Option
options.description: Lets a relay agent/client indicate which subnet an address should come from.

options.name: Domain Search
options.description: DNS search suffix list, for resolving unqualified hostnames.

options.name: SIP Servers
options.description: SIP outbound proxy servers for the client.

options.name: Classless Static Route
options.description: Static routes as (prefix, router) pairs, replacing option 33 with CIDR-style prefixes.

options.name: CableLabs Client Configuration
options.description: CableLabs-specific configuration for cable modems/eDVAs.

options.name: GeoConf
options.description: Coordinate-based (latitude/longitude) location information for the client.

options.name: Vendor-Identifying Vendor Class
options.description: Vendor class data, tagged with an IANA enterprise number.

options.name: Vendor-Identifying Vendor-Specific Information
options.description: Vendor-specific data, tagged with an IANA enterprise number.

options.name: PANA Authentication Agent
options.description: Address of a PANA (Protocol for Carrying Authentication for Network Access) agent.

options.name: LoST Server
options.description: Location-to-Service Translation (LoST) server, for location-based/emergency services.

options.name: CAPWAP Access Controller Addresses
options.description: CAPWAP access controller addresses for wireless termination points.

options.name: MoS IPv4 Address (802.21)
options.description: IEEE 802.21 Media Independent Handover Mobility Services server addresses.

options.name: MoS FQDN (802.21)
options.description: IEEE 802.21 Media Independent Handover Mobility Services server domain names.

options.name: SIP UA Configuration Service Domains
options.description: Domains for a SIP User Agent to query for its configuration.

options.name: ANDSF IPv4 Address
options.description: Access Network Discovery and Selection Function server addresses.

options.name: SZTP Redirect
options.description: Bootstrap server URIs for Secure Zero Touch Provisioning.

options.name: Forcerenew Nonce Capable
options.description: Whether the client supports authenticated FORCERENEW messages.

options.name: RDNSS Selection
options.description: Lets the server indicate which of several DNS resolvers to prefer, with a selection priority.

options.name: DOTS Reference Identifier
options.description: Identifies a DDoS Open Threat Signaling (DOTS) agent.

options.name: DOTS Address
options.description: Address of a DOTS agent.

options.name: TFTP Server Address / Etherboot / GRUB Config Path
Port Parameters
options.description: Port-restricted address parameters, e.g. for CGN/lightweight 4over6 deployments.

options.name: MUD URL
options.description: URL for this device's Manufacturer Usage Description file, describing its expected network behavior.

options.name: PXELINUX Magic
options.description: Fixed magic number identifying that the remaining options are PXELINUX-specific.

options.name: PXELINUX Configuration File
options.description: Name of the PXELINUX configuration file to load.

options.name: PXELINUX Path Prefix
options.description: Path prefix PXELINUX should use when loading further files.

options.name: PXELINUX Reboot Time
options.description: How long PXELINUX should wait before rebooting after a failure.

options.name: OPTION_6RD
options.description: 6rd (IPv6 Rapid Deployment) configuration: border relay address, prefix, and IPv4 mask length.

options.name: End
options.description: Marks the end of the options field.
